content: Each document INLINEFORM0 is represented by two vectors in INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 . The first vector exists in a “monolingual space” (of dimensionality INLINEFORM3 ) and is based on a bag-of-words representation of the document. The second vector exists in a “crosslingual space” (of dimensionality INLINEFORM4 ) which is common to all languages. More details about these representations are discussed in § SECREF4 .
